new_value: {"notes":"Implemented allocation-free per-link CSMA state machine in csma.c/csma.h with atomic nonblocking operation ownership and async cancellation; deterministic injectable RNG uses multiplication-high uniform mapping; transitions cover initial/exponential backoff, CAD clear/busy/timeout/hardware error, exponent cap 5, 10 ms slots, fourth-attempt exhaustion after retry limit 3, TX completion, reset, cancellation, invalid phase, RNG failure, and concurrent access. Integrated state lifetime into lichen_link_ctx and Zephyr link CMake. Added pthread-backed focused tests including cancel during an in-flight RNG callback. Local AppleClang strict C23 compile, UBSan csma test, csma_constants test, packets-timing format-v2 regeneration check (38 vectors), and diff check pass. link_ctx objects compile with the existing host explicit_bzero compatibility substitution; that legacy target still has unrelated pre-existing missing tx_queue_init link wiring. No HAL files or externally owned workstation touched."}
CAD-based CSMA/CA state machine, context integration, deterministic RNG, fail-closed transitions, concurrency/cancellation, and focused host tests complete.
